method: D(t) = A(t) - B(t), the difference of the two regions' deseasonalized fixed-mask monthly means on the months where both have a value; Sen's slope with 95% CI and Mann-Kendall (same autocorrelation handling as the regional trends) on D. 'trends differ' when p < alpha. P-values of the two regions are never compared, and overlapping confidence intervals are not used as a test.
note: Each p-value is valid for one comparison chosen in advance. Looking through many pairs and picking those that differ raises the chance of false positives: about 1 in 20 pairs with no real difference will show 'trends differ'. Overlapping boxes share cells, so their results are not independent.
q_note: q_across_pairs: Benjamini-Hochberg q-value across all region pairs of this variable, for scanning many pairs at once. Approximate: the pairs share regions and are not independent.
